SELECT d.dates, d.version, d.pkg, d.user_type,-- 假设新用户数、次日留存数、三日留存数、活跃用户数、人均在线时长等信息不在 DWS 表中直接提供， -- 这里需要根据实际情况调整或使用默认值 IFNULL(ddpr.user_num, 0) new_user_num, IFNULL(ddpr2.retention_user_num, 0) second_user_num, IFNULL(ddpr3.retention_user_num, 0) tertiary_user_num, ddpl.user_num active_user_num, IFNULL(ddpo.avg_user_online_time, 0) avg_user_online_time,
-- 入门游戏相关数据 d.intro_user_count, d.intro_user_count / ddpl.user_num intro_user_rate, d.intro_game_reward intro_game_reward, IFNULL(d.intro_avg_reward, 0) intro_avg_game_reward,
-- 转盘游戏相关数据 d.turn_user_count, IFNULL(d.turn_game_count / d.turn_user_count, 0) turn_avg_game_count, d.turn_user_count / ddpl.user_num turn_user_rate, d.turn_game_consume turn_game_consume, d.turn_game_reward turn_game_reward, IFNULL(d.turn_avg_consume, 0) turn_avg_game_consume, IFNULL(d.turn_avg_reward, 0) turn_avg_game_reward,
-- 小游戏相关数据
ifnull(ddpe.exchange_chip_count,0) as mini_exchange_chip_count, ifnull(ddpe.exchange_cash_count,0) as mini_exchange_ch_count, ifnull(ddpe.exchange_cash_total_amount,0) as mini_exchange_ch_amount, ifnull(ddpe.exchange_chip_total_amount,0) as mini_exchange_chip_amount, d.mini_user_count, IFNULL(d.mini_game_count / ddpl.user_num, 0) mini_avg_game_count, IFNULL(d.mini_game_time / ddpl.user_num, 0) mini_avg_game_time, d.mini_user_count / ddpl.user_num mini_user_rate, d.mini_game_consume mini_game_consume, IFNULL(d.mini_avg_consume, 0) mini_avg_game_consume, d.mini_game_reward mini_game_reward, IFNULL(d.mini_avg_reward, 0) mini_avg_game_reward, d.mini_rtp, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS create_time
FROM dws_daily_package_all_game d left join dws_daily_package_all_asset_exchange ddpe on (d.dates = ddpe.dates and d.pkg = ddpe.pkg and d.version =ddpe.version)
LEFT JOIN dws_daily_package_all_login ddpl on (d.dates = ddpl.dates and d.pkg = ddpl.pkg and d.version = ddpl.version) LEFT JOIN dws_daily_package_all_register ddpr ON (ddpl.dates = ddpr.dates AND ddpl.pkg = ddpr.pkg AND ddpl.version = ddpr.version) LEFT JOIN dws_daily_package_all_retention ddpr2 ON ( ddpl.dates = ddpr2.register_dates AND ddpl.pkg = ddpr2.pkg AND ddpl.version = ddpr2.version AND ddpr2.register_day = 1 ) LEFT JOIN dws_daily_package_all_retention ddpr3 ON ( ddpl.dates = ddpr3.register_dates AND ddpl.pkg = ddpr3.pkg AND ddpl.version = ddpr3.version AND ddpr3.register_day = 2 ) LEFT JOIN dws_daily_package_all_online ddpo ON (ddpl.dates = ddpo.dates AND ddpl.pkg = ddpo.pkg AND ddpl.version = ddpo.version)
WHERE d.dates = #{dates} and d.user_type = 0;-- 假定日期为2024年8月1日，可根据实际情况调整

SELECT d.dates, d.version, d.pkg, d.user_type,-- 假设新用户数、次日留存数、三日留存数、活跃用户数、人均在线时长等信息不在 DWS 表中直接提供， -- 这里需要根据实际情况调整或使用默认值 IFNULL(ddpr.user_num, 0) new_user_num, IFNULL(ddpr2.retention_user_num, 0) second_user_num, IFNULL(ddpr3.retention_user_num, 0) tertiary_user_num, ddpl.user_num active_user_num, IFNULL(ddpo.avg_new_user_online_time, 0) avg_user_online_time,
-- 入门游戏相关数据 d.intro_user_count, d.intro_user_count / ddpl.user_num intro_user_rate, d.intro_game_reward intro_game_reward, IFNULL(d.intro_avg_reward, 0) intro_avg_game_reward,
-- 转盘游戏相关数据 d.turn_user_count, IFNULL(d.turn_game_count / d.turn_user_count, 0) turn_avg_game_count, d.turn_user_count / ddpl.user_num turn_user_rate, d.turn_game_consume turn_game_consume, d.turn_game_reward turn_game_reward, IFNULL(d.turn_avg_consume, 0) turn_avg_game_consume, IFNULL(d.turn_avg_reward, 0) turn_avg_game_reward,
-- 小游戏相关数据
ifnull(ddpe.exchange_chip_count,0) as mini_exchange_chip_count, ifnull(ddpe.exchange_cash_count,0) as mini_exchange_ch_count, ifnull(ddpe.exchange_cash_total_amount,0) as mini_exchange_ch_amount, ifnull(ddpe.exchange_chip_total_amount,0) as mini_exchange_chip_amount, d.mini_user_count, IFNULL(d.mini_game_count / ddpl.user_num, 0) mini_avg_game_count, IFNULL(d.mini_game_time / ddpl.user_num, 0) mini_avg_game_time, d.mini_user_count / ddpl.user_num mini_user_rate, d.mini_game_consume mini_game_consume, IFNULL(d.mini_avg_consume, 0) mini_avg_game_consume, d.mini_game_reward mini_game_reward, IFNULL(d.mini_avg_reward, 0) mini_avg_game_reward, d.mini_rtp, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS create_time
FROM dws_daily_package_all_game d left join dws_daily_package_all_asset_exchange ddpe on (d.dates = ddpe.dates and d.pkg = ddpe.pkg and d.version =ddpe.version) LEFT JOIN dws_daily_package_all_login ddpl on (d.dates = ddpl.dates and d.pkg = ddpl.pkg and d.version = ddpl.version) LEFT JOIN dws_daily_package_all_register ddpr ON (ddpl.dates = ddpr.dates AND ddpl.pkg = ddpr.pkg AND ddpl.version = ddpr.version) LEFT JOIN dws_daily_package_all_retention ddpr2 ON ( ddpl.dates = ddpr2.register_dates AND ddpl.pkg = ddpr2.pkg AND ddpl.version = ddpr2.version AND ddpr2.register_day = 1 ) LEFT JOIN dws_daily_package_all_retention ddpr3 ON ( ddpl.dates = ddpr3.register_dates AND ddpl.pkg = ddpr3.pkg AND ddpl.version = ddpr3.version AND ddpr3.register_day = 2 ) LEFT JOIN dws_daily_package_all_online ddpo ON (ddpl.dates = ddpo.dates AND ddpl.pkg = ddpo.pkg AND ddpl.version = ddpo.version)
WHERE d.dates = #{dates} and d.user_type = 1;-- 假定日期为2024年8月1日，可根据实际情况调整
